name: BTC-dominance-rotation regime gates an alt long — risk-on-within-crypto confluence (dominance falling AND macro calm)
rationale: THESIS: BTC dominance (BTC's share of total crypto mcap) is a cross-sectional 'rotation' read that single-name desks under-trade because it is RELATIVE market structure, not a price on any one instrument: FALLING dominance = capital rotating out of BTC into alts (risk-on within crypto), RISING dominance = a flight to BTC. The genuinely novel structure is CONFLUENCE / regime-GATING — only arm an alt long when BOTH (a) intra-crypto rotation favors alts (dominance is FALLING, captured as a downward CROSS of a fitted level, NOT a raw-level read) AND (b) the macro risk regime is constructive (vix_level below a fitted ~70th-pct ceiling, i.e. not in stress). Neither leg alone is the edge; the AND of them arms a different book than plain alt momentum. While armed, we only BUY a name once its short-horizon ret_Nd has turned positive (the rotation is actually showing up in THAT name) — so dominance+vix select the REGIME and ret_Nd selects the TIMING. Long-only spot (no shorts on Binance spot). MANDATORY DISCONFIRMERS — the deterministic Gate disposes, this is authored to be falsified, not tuned to pass: (1) SUBSUMPTION / 'is it just alt momentum?' — run the identical ret_Nd>0 entry with the dominance gate REMOVED; if unconditional alt momentum matches or beats this spec's deflated Sharpe, the dominance gate adds nothing and this is plain alt momentum, which is EXHAUSTED → FALSIFIED. (2) CONFLUENCE-NECESSITY / 'does vix matter?' — drop the vix leg; if dominance+momentum alone match the full three-leg spec, the CONFLUENCE claim is false and one filter is dead weight. (3) DRIFT-TRAP / 'is it the level in disguise?' — cg_btc_dominance is a DRIFTING raw-level snapshot, so a fitted lt/gt on its LEVEL would be an always-true/false trap; this spec binds ONLY the directional CHANGE via cross_down (entry) / cross_up (exit). A control that swaps cross_down for a static lt on the raw dominance level must NOT reproduce the edge — if it does, the result is a level-in-disguise artifact, not rotation. PRIOR (honest): cross-sectional rotation signals usually collapse into momentum under disconfirmer 1; expected outcome is maybe, leaning likely-fail. tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS — the Gate down-weights until it earns its place.
catalyst: BTC dominance crosses DOWN through a fitted level (capital rotating into alts) WHILE equity VIX is below its stress ceiling (macro calm), and the alt's own short-horizon return has turned positive
